text: Stock is reserved all-or-nothing before any payment is requested, and the short-stock branch ends with no payment requested and the customer told which items are short.
Shows the 10-minute reservation hold and what happens when it lapses (the stock goes back on sale).
Charge requests carry the order id as the idempotency key. The payment outcome arrives by webhook up to 30 minutes later, and repeated deliveries are not processed twice.
Shows the late-success branch: a payment that succeeds after the stock is gone leads to an automatic full refund, an out-of-stock cancellation and an email to the customer, with no partial shipment.
Shows the declined-payment branch and the failed-refund branch, with refunds never silently dropped.
The cart is emptied only after the order is confirmed and is left unchanged on every failure path.
Says which service does each step and what each service stores, with no service reading another's database.
Delivered as a Mermaid flowchart with short notes before or after it.
